---
title: "Visualization"
format: html
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read_csv("data/raw/pipes.csv")
```


```{r}
bin <- 100  

surface_grid <- data |>
  filter(!is.na(Surface)) |>
  mutate(
    xm = (`GPS x1` + `GPS x2`) / 2,
    ym = (`GPS y1` + `GPS y2`) / 2,
    gx = floor(xm / bin) * bin + bin / 2, 
    gy = floor(ym / bin) * bin + bin / 2
  ) |>
  count(gx, gy, Surface) |>
  group_by(gx, gy) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>  # most common surface per cell
  ungroup()

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = surface_grid,
    aes(x = gx, y = gy, fill = Surface),
    width = bin, height = bin, alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data,
    aes(x = `GPS x1`, y = `GPS y1`,
        xend = `GPS x2`, yend = `GPS y2`,
        colour = Material)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
ggplot(surface_grid, aes(x = gx, y = gy, fill = Surface)) +
  geom_tile(width = bin, height = bin) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Surface", x = "GPS x", y = "GPS y") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data, aes(
  x = `GPS x1`, y = `GPS y1`,
  xend = `GPS x2`, yend = `GPS y2`,
  colour = Material
)) +
  geom_segment() +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Pipe material", x = "GPS x", y = "GPS y") +
  theme_minimal()
```
